description.text: Objective: This project is undertaken by School of Economics of WUT. It aims at training students abilities of research and application in fields like Economic Development, Industrial Organization, International Trade, Investment, Environment and Resources and Financial Management.The team of teachers is composed of professors graduate from distinguished universities in Europe and USA (such as Yale University and Oxford University). They are all experienced in teaching and direction international students. Distinguished Nobel Prize winners –Professore Robert A. Mundell from Columbia University and Professor Clive W.F.Granger both came to the school of Economics to give lectures. Research Orientation: Industrial organizations and enterprises competition, development strategy and planning of regional economies, international investigation and management of multinational companies, financial innovation and financial engineering, as well as environmental and resource economics

duration.text: The Economics at Wuhan University of Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Research plan Postgraduate school transcript

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, who haven’t broken laws, are required to have master degree.
